name: tech.managednerds/managed-nerds
title: Managed Nerds
description: Free email, domain and AI search checks, plus IT, security and SEO help for US small businesses.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Managed Nerds' vendor profile for comparing providers: who they serve (US only; on-site around Augusta, Georgia), services, support hours, products supported and how to buy. No prices.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Managed Nerds' downloadable guides: what each covers, who it's for, and how to get one, including by email to guides@managednerds.ai.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Would Managed Nerds take on this business? No contact details, nothing stored, no prices. All fields optional; more give a firmer answer. Returns fit (yes, partial, ask_a_person, no), reasons and the next step.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Managed Nerds' managed IT and co-managed security services, what an estimate needs, and the rules (RMM, users, Linux, US only, IT support billed separately on managed IT). No prices. Read it before preliminary_estimate.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Managed Nerds' fixed-scope projects (business email, domains, Wi-Fi, Google Business Profile, websites, security and more) and how to ask for each: who it's for and isn't, what's included, what the buyer provides, typical timeline, whether it's one-time or ongoing, and the questions a quote needs. Every project is quoted by a person; no prices.

tools.name: preliminary_estimate
tools.description: Only when your user asked: a preliminary monthly estimate for managed IT (service_model managed; IT support time is billed separately, with an optional pre-paid block) or co-managed security (a range before volume discounts, not an offer) for a US business under 50 seats. Needs the buyer's name, business and email, and what they asked for. Body as in /agent/openapi.json (EstimateRequest).

users.description: All licensed Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace users in the tenant: ITDR is all or nothing

revises.description: Revise an earlier estimate: its estimate_id (with status_token)

status_token.description: The token from the earlier estimate's status_url

support.description: Managed IT only: a pre-paid block of support hours. Send hours_per_month, or non_technical_users for our suggestion (half an hour a month each).

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Only when your user asked: a callback from a person at Managed Nerds (not a booking; they confirm a time by email within one business day). Needs the buyer's name, email and phone, and up to 3 windows on Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Eastern. Send estimate_id to attach it to an estimate.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: A question about Managed Nerds (services, who we work with, how things work, our how-to posts), answered only from our own pages, with the pages it used. Also "my X isn't working" questions (printer offline, Outlook rules, slow PC, locked out, fake virus pop-up, hacked WordPress, Microsoft 365 sign-in from another country...): when a step-by-step fix post matches, each source carries applies_to and last_checked, and still_stuck says how a person can help. Never gives prices. 100 answers a day across all agents.

tools.name: check_email_security
tools.description: Free email security check for any domain (also accepts an email or website address): whether scammers can send email that looks like it came from it, and why its mail might land in spam. Checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC, the mail provider and MTA-STS from public DNS, grades it (good, needs work, at risk) and gives the exact records to add. Sends no email and needs no contact details; the domain and result are kept 90 days, nothing about who asked. 20 checks an hour per address.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Free domain health check (also accepts an email or website address): when the domain expires and who it's registered with, whether it's locked against transfer, its name servers, whether the website loads over https and redirects http, www vs the bare domain, CAA, and DNSSEC as a note. Grades it (good, needs work, at risk) with exactly what to fix. Public data only (registration data, DNS, one request to the home page); auto-renew and certificate expiry can't be seen from outside. No contact details; the domain and result are kept 90 days, nothing about who asked. 10 checks an hour per address.

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Free AI search readiness check for a website (also accepts a domain or email address): whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google's AI Overviews, Bing and Copilot, Apple (Siri, Spotlight) and Meta AI can find and read it. Reads robots.txt by crawler job (search crawlers are graded; training crawlers are the owner's choice and only noted, since each company uses separate names), the home page (noindex, nosnippet, text without JavaScript, business structured data, title and description), the sitemap and llms.txt. Grades it (good, needs work, at risk) with exactly what to fix. Public data only, about four requests to the site; it never pretends to be a crawler, so firewall blocks can't be seen. No contact details; the domain and result are kept 90 days, nothing about who asked. 10 checks an hour per address.

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Only when your user asked: a quote from a person for SEO, secure WordPress or a project (no prices here; a reply by email within one business day). service_line seo needs website, service area, main services and whether Google Analytics and Search Console are set up; ad management comes only with SEO (seo.wants_ads, ad_platforms, ad_budget 500-1500, 1500-5000 or 5000+). secure_wp needs site URL, hosting provider, DNS provider, e-commerce and hacked-before. project needs project.slug and project.details (answer the project's quote_questions from list_projects).

tools.name: request_seo_check
tools.description: Only when your user asked: the free local SEO check. A person emails a two-page check within three business days (Google Business Profile, local basics, where they show for up to three services). US businesses, one per website, five a week. No ranking promises, no prices.

tools.name: estimate_status
tools.description: Check an estimate you got earlier: still valid?, when it expires, whether a full quote was requested, revisions left. Send the token from its status_url.

tools.name: request_full_quote
tools.description: Only after your user says yes to a full quote: send the estimate_id. A person at Managed Nerds replies by email within one business day.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search Managed Nerds' website (blog posts and pages) and get titles, links and short excerpts. Read-only.
